g1-implement.title: Canonical initial cut: implement
g1-implement.imperative: Fill the Implementer handoff and dispatch constellation-implementer. TDD first: hard-rename skills/to-issues to skills/to-initial-issues and constellation-to-initial-issues. Freeze `skills/to-initial-issues/templates/SHAPED_BRIEF.template.json` as the single Explorer-to-cutter input: schema_version integer exactly 1; title and source_path nonempty strings; confirmation object {status exactly CONFIRMED, confirmed_by nonempty string, date nonempty ISO date}; intent_and_why nonempty string; definition_of_done nonempty array of nonempty strings; good_enough {mandatory_quality, sufficient_evidence, appetite} nonempty strings; hard_constraints and fixed_decisions arrays of nonempty strings may be empty; initial_wave {objective nonempty string, exit_criteria nonempty array}; wave_forecast, uncertainty_register, parked_possibilities use the output shapes below and may be empty; evidence_digest array may be empty, each entry {claim, source, conclusion} nonempty strings. The cutter consumes this artifact directly—no prose translation—and adds issue drafts to produce the output manifest; a seam test instantiates Explorer's template, confirms it, feeds it directly to the initial-cut verifier/renderer, and asserts field-preserving output. Define the checked-in strict output manifest: schema_version integer 1; epic object retains title and spec_path/source identity and contains intent_and_why; definition_of_done; good_enough; hard_constraints; fixed_decisions; current_wave {objective, exit_criteria[], nonempty issues[]}; wave_forecast[]; uncertainty_register[]; parked_possibilities[]. Forecast entries require nonempty outcome/why_likely and entry_conditions array may be empty. Uncertainty entries require nonempty unknown/affects/settle_by/current_evidence/next_probe. Runnable issues exist only in current_wave.issues and require nonempty id/title/desired_outcome/useful_now/appetite/acceptance_or_falsification_evidence/implementation_latitude; hard_constraints_no_gos and local_unknowns arrays may be empty; anchors nonempty string array; type AFK|HITL; blocks may be empty; hitl_reason only for HITL. Forecast has no id/type/body/blocks; filer iterates only issues. Missing/empty/wrong-type/enum/unknown-contract violations fail fast. Zero edges valid; existing targets/cycles checked. Render exactly eight headings: Intent and why; Definition of done; Good-enough boundary and appetite; Hard constraints and fixed decisions; Current wave; Wave forecast (nonbinding); Active uncertainty register; Parked possibilities. Preserve adapters and strengthen idempotency: epic and every child crash windows; receipt manifest/key mismatch fail-fast; forecast find/create spy. Installer migration: selecting canonical detects exact legacy destination; without --force refuses with migration command; with --force removes only legacy then installs canonical; dry-run no mutation; subset/full leave exactly canonical. Rename inventory includes README, index, overview/positioning, write-a-skill example, Explorer live route, registry, docstrings, and test rename; exact allowlist preserves archives, legacy transcript fixtures, and external/removability provenance. No alias. Same focused test command red on intended behavior then green; result includes gate_id=g1, digest, tests-before-code, identical commands/outputs, and inventory.

g2-implement.imperative: Fill the Implementer handoff and dispatch constellation-implementer. Apply constellation-write-a-skill: mint lean constellation-replan and freeze versioned JSON templates/reference plus pure verifier/renderer. REPLAN_INPUT schema_version=1 requires: current_plan (exact G1 output); completed_outcomes may be empty with {issue_id,outcome,evidence} nonempty; wave_evidence nonempty with {claim,expected,observed,source} nonempty; discrepancies may be empty with {id,signal,classification,affects,evidence,reason}, classification blocks_current_wave_exit|invalidates_forecast_or_decomposition|later_only|evidence_only|drop and reason mandatory for drop; open_current_wave_issue_ids string array; unlaunched_items may be empty with {id nonempty, kind issue|forecast|uncertainty|parked}; repo_state {anchors may be empty, map_status nonempty}. REPLAN_RESULT schema_version=1 requires decision advance|repair|replan|stop; applicable boolean; criteria_assessment {wave_exit,epic_done,good_enough} nonempty; one discrepancy_disposition per input {id, action repair_current_wave|revise_plan|amend_forecast_or_parked|record_evidence_only|drop, reason, issue_created}, with issue_created=false for evidence_only/drop; current_wave exact G1 shape or null only for stop; revised_forecast exact G1 forecast entries, revised_uncertainty exact G1 uncertainty entries, revised_parked exact G1 nonempty-string entries. One unlaunched_disposition per input {id, action keep|rewrite|reorder|defer|delete, reason, replacement}; replacement absent except rewrite and discriminated by input kind: full G1 issue object, exact G1 forecast object, exact G1 uncertainty object, or nonempty parked string. material_changes {surface,before,after,reason}; nonempty wave_review_comment and revised_epic_body. escalation null or {boundary,proposed_value,reason,authority_required}; boundary intent_and_why|definition_of_done|good_enough|hard_constraints|fixed_decisions and proposed_value boundary-typed: nonempty string, nonempty string array, exact G1 good_enough object, or string array (may empty) respectively. applicable=true preserves fixed fields and launched identities; any fixed delta requires escalation and applicable=false. Missing/wrong-type/unknown enum/identity, wrong-kind replacement, and wrong-boundary proposed_value fail fast. Tests cover all exits, repair hold, evidence-only, launched stability, complete dispositions, wrong discriminators, render, offline. G3 consumes exact templates. Same focused red/green; result includes gate_id=g2, digest, tests-before-code, identical commands/outputs.
